sources.institution: University of Dhaka, Department of Statistics
sources.role: Syllabus foundation for B.S. Honours in Statistics (Courses Stat H-204 Economic Statistics & Stat H-210 Lab)

sources.institution: Allen, R.G.D. (1975). Index Numbers in Theory and Practice
sources.role: Rigorous mathematical reference for axiomatic tests, Laspeyres/Paasche/Fisher indices, and economic theory of index numbers

sources.institution: United Nations, European Commission, IMF, OECD, World Bank (2009). System of National Accounts 2008 (SNA 2008)
sources.role: International statistical standard for national accounting, GDP/GNP concepts, and input-output supply-use tables

sources.institution: Kakwani, N.C. (1980). Income Inequality and Poverty: Methods of Estimation and Policy Applications
sources.role: Analytical foundation for Lorenz curve geometry, Gini concentration index, Atkinson index, and FGT poverty measures

sources.institution: Box, G.E.P., Jenkins, G.M., Reinsel, G.C., & Ljung, G.M. (2015). Time Series Analysis: Forecasting and Control
sources.role: Classical treatment of time series components, trend estimation, moving average smoothing, and seasonal decomposition
